decisions.reason: The Postulate attributes iq_n gamma^a to any particle, but its actual QFT-G02 supplier restricts that vertex to Dirac species. Tong section 6.5.1 instead gives scalar momentum and two-photon vertices. Replaced particle by Dirac species and made A1 explicit; the separately adopted scalar contact and decay rules are preserved.

Step 1.1 incorrectly equates natural photon momentum with the joule-valued P: the actual denominator is s/(hbar c)^2. This is nonfatal because A2 independently adopts the exact amplitude and the trace, current-conservation and coefficient calculations follow from that premise. Repaired the step by explicitly converting photon momentum and rescaling all four external spinors, so both current factors cancel the propagator scale and recover g^2/s.
